Name: Gay Chickens
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
This mod will turn all of your chickens into rainbow-coloured chickens. The colours will shift and change over time, like prismatic clothing and such, but unlike other prismatic things, these chickens will specifically be the rainbow colours of the gay flag.

These aren't [i]new[/i] chickens. They alter the textures of existing chickens. Even modded ones! They will still look like the original mods, just gayer.

[b]Installation[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Fixed: Chickens not being as gay as they ought to be for some people in some circumstances.
